prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic luxury fashion portrait of one approved adult woman crouching low against a clean white seamless studio background with supplied playing-card graphics in the corners.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with short blonde pixie haircut, soft natural makeup, calm neutral expression, direct eye contact, and realistic natural skin texture. She wears an oversized ribbed knit sweater with a gray-to-charcoal gradient, long sleeves covering part of the hands, high-waisted brown leather pants, and black pointed high-heel pumps.
composition_elements: Subject crouches low with knees bent and one hand resting on her cheek; the other hand hangs naturally between the knees.
Clean white seamless background with minimal shadows and luxury editorial negative space.
Preserve the supplied black playing-card 2-of-clubs graphics at the upper-left and lower-right corners, including their orientation and scale.
Keep sweater ribbing, gradient, leather grain, shoes, face, and pose sharply readable.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting with minimal shadows, cool-neutral color grading, controlled highlights on leather, natural skin rendering, and a modern high-fashion campaign atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens look, shallow depth of field, sharp focus, realistic knit, leather, skin, and graphic edges, high resolution, subtle natural grain, no added text or watermark.
